title: Claude Code Configuration & Workflows
note: Labels must match app/verify/module_01.py exactly. All 17 checks map to exactly one step; if that stops being true, this file is stale and /check will under-report.

1.title: CLAUDE.md
1.limit: Existence only. This passes whether the file was derived or pasted, and whether its contents are good or useless.

2.title: Permissions
labels: corpus writes are denied at the permission layer

3.title: A PreToolUse hook that protects the corpus
labels: hook DENIES a write inside corpus/
hook ALLOWS a write inside coach/
hook DENIES a traversal path into corpus/
3.note: The last three execute the hook with synthetic stdin. The ALLOWS check exists to catch a hook that denies everything and looks like it works.

4.title: A PostToolUse hook that formats on save
labels: a PreToolUse hook is registered for Write|Edit
a PostToolUse hook is registered for Write|Edit
the PreToolUse command names a hook script that exists
4.limit: Registration and script existence only. Neither hook has ever been fired by a real Claude Code session — that cannot be asserted offline.

6.title: CI
6.limit: Existence only. The workflow file is never parsed or run here; confirm CI locally with `ruff check . && pytest -q`.
